# The Obstacle Course Game You’ve Been Waiting For!

**RUN, JUMP, PUNCH & SMASH** your way through 40+ levels and dungeons in this retro-themed VR platformer & obstacle course game. Filled with tough challenges, inventive obstacles, treasures to collect and secrets to discover.

![{"height":320,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974469_465167519875389_7799963844292711505_n.png?_nc_cat=103&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=D7iyniF3qEIQ7kNvgGQaBEn&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBeC584OF-wXgSGRBuRPy7I5I-aA-KOtnTh2o8V4v_DBw&oe=671F6355)

# 7 Worlds To Discover

- Honeywood Hills
- Cookie Crumble
- Sky Brick Road
- Jump N' Jammy
- Arctic Freeze
- Dark Citadel 
- Cybertron

![{"height":316,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57570288_519192850905056_7008045554147306501_n.png?_nc_cat=109&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=dHzZNwJDkx4Q7kNvgFmt9d9&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCO2ijTmrzfOn-7OA2XvwZPKG2LBY8HD4eiupRMSX-H3Q&oe=671F65E2)

# Easy To Pickup And Play

- Play Seated or Standing.
- Movement - Left & Right Thumbsticks.
- Jump - A Button or Click Right Thumbstick.
- Dash - Click Left Thumbstick.
- Ground Smash - While in Air, Press Trigger.

![{"height":320,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38984458_467766535619537_6073863993821564424_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=xOaif_b0r0UQ7kNvgGtPF9r&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAi_FHg8lcYnrVyTlQyqRuCzYuqqEW7977PZ1kUxemHNQ&oe=671F8B45)
# Face the final challenge. Enter each of the 7 Dungeons and see if you have what it takes to unlock the next world.
- Untimed so you can progress at your own pace.
- Reach the gates to unlock checkpoints.
- Dungeons designed with platforming in mind.

![{"height":320,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75221317_543457818269844_6485753983236722891_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=NydRZxg0M-oQ7kNvgGnbGN1&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBNZu4HDKfx6idSwH8Vqt-GK7dyMy7pzRF4Rum_xZXigQ&oe=671F747F)
# Race To The Finish Line!
- Race against your own time.
- Compete to achieve Bronze, Silver or Gold Trophies!
- You aren't penalized for a lack of skill.
- As long as you can complete each course, you can progress!
- Keep practicing and you'll do GREAT!
